title: Yoyo's Birthday Party
audience: Chinese primary school students (10-12 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A four-panel comic of Yoyo's 11th birthday party: invitation card, parents decorating, birthday dinner with Chinese and Western food, children playing a board game
imageDescription: A four-panel comic about Yoyo's birthday party. Panel 1 shows an invitation card on a desk: "YOYO's 11th Birthday Party! Join the fun!" — Date: Saturday, Oct. 26; Time: 2 PM; Place: Yoyo's House; RSVP: Auntie Chen. Panel 2 shows the living room, where Mum and Dad hang a "Happy Birthday YOYO!" banner under colorful balloons; a cake with candles waits on the coffee table and the family dog stands beside Dad. Panel 3 shows children around a round table with a two-tier cake topped with "11", Chinese dishes (steamed buns, dumplings, noodles) and Western dishes (pizza, fried chicken, pasta, fries, cupcakes, fruit and juice). Panel 4 shows Yoyo and four friends laughing while playing a board game under the banner.
scoringDescription: A four-panel comic telling the story of Yoyo's 11th birthday party. Panel 1 shows a printed invitation card on a wooden desk next to a cup and papers: "YOYO's 11th Birthday Party! Join the fun! Date: Saturday, Oct. 26. Time: 2 PM. Place: Yoyo's House. RSVP: Auntie Chen. Be there!" — this tells whose birthday it is, when and where the party is, and that Yoyo is turning 11. Panel 2 shows the preparation: Mum in a pink top and Dad in a blue shirt hang a big "Happy Birthday YOYO!" banner in the living room, with colorful balloons and triangular bunting; a cream cake with candles stands on the coffee table and the family dog stands beside Dad. Panel 3 shows the birthday dinner: children sit around a round table with a two-tier strawberry cake topped with the number 11, Chinese food such as steamed buns in bamboo baskets, noodles and dumplings, and Western food such as pizza, fried chicken, French fries, spaghetti, cupcakes, fruit plates and glasses of juice; everyone is eating happily. Panel 4 shows the after-dinner games: five children, including Yoyo, a girl in a yellow shirt, sit around a small table playing a colorful board game with cards, laughing under the "Happy Birthday YOYO!" banner and balloons.
